scope: Initial source review of FIXTURE single-close finalization, immutable outbox/receipt and seven declared source/migration subjects

findings.description: The only five-second checks use caller-captured now before BEGIN IMMEDIATE. Under-lock original_refs, account claim scans and canonical snapshot validation can consume the remaining window, but INSERT and lease validation still use that old time. A newly expired source can become a durable replayable finalization batch.
findings.minimal_fix: Pass the trusted composition clock to staging; after all under-lock semantic scans, validate the original unrenewed source intervals and actual lease with a final sampled time immediately before the outbox INSERT.
findings.minimal_regression: Using genuine issued reads, advance the actual fixture clock from4.9 to5.1 seconds after a real final staging semantic scan. Require no outbox/receipt/canonical prefix.

findings.description: The original terminal source_hash is persisted by the application, but original_refs reparses its retained row without comparing observed.source_hash to source.terminal_confirmation.source_hash. Altering only this declared commitment and updating bundle serialization/hash does not change E5 effects or original_refs, allowing a false terminal provenance commitment in the published receipt.
findings.minimal_fix: Validate the terminal source commitment against the exact retained bounded raw material used for parsing. Preserve sufficient full-row material if normalization removed fields, or fail closed for that unsupported representation.
findings.minimal_regression: Mutate only terminal_confirmation.source_hash in an otherwise genuine owner-produced source bundle and reserialize it. Stage/recovery must deny before any canonical prefix or receipt.

supported_static_conclusions: Distinct-journal guard rejects shared connection, active transaction, absent main database and samefile aliases before stage/publish. It resolves the inspected unchanged-canonical-writer same-file/nested-transaction design problem without adding a database.

Staging commits the immutable outbox separately. Publisher owns one dispatch _write, validates original lease/batch/stable semantic claim history, invokes only normal canonical facade writes plus private receipt SQL, and avoids guard/recovery/public mark wrapper nesting.
Both migration tables have FK lineage, immutable UPDATE/DELETE and BEFORE INSERT duplicate guards. Publication requires the exact original stored batch and re-computed existing E5 effects.

Replay validates ordered exact0/1/2/3 prefixes, actual expected recovery diagnostics/current pointers, and only strips the exact own projection/binding/TradeResult before baseline comparison. No arbitrary READY synthesis is persisted.

Stable claim commitment covers actual account operation rows across ENTRY/PROTECTION_STOP/POSITION_EXIT/EMERGENCY_EXIT; connection-local tuple is used only as a fresh race fence, not stored authority.
limits: This artifact records the captured initial seven subjects, which may subsequently be repaired by root. No reviewer tests/imports/DB/process/native/Git/network/provider or tracked edits occurred. Only this authorized outside-Git review JSON was written.
